title: Platform Gap Analysis Remediation — DuckDB LTAP, Caddy Ingress, & CRDT State Engine
description: Remediates architectural gaps by adding DuckDB analytical OLAP querying, Caddy automated TLS/subdomain routing, CRDT Yjs/Automerge sync protocol, Riba-free fee split engine, and hash-chained audit trails.
keyDecisions: DUCKDB FOR ANALYTICAL OLAP AGGREGATION. Combine SQLite for transactional reads/writes with embedded DuckDB for cross-app analytics and Shura dashboard reporting.
CADDY REVERSE PROXY FOR AUTOMATED TLS. Integrate Caddy admin API to provision dynamic subdomains (*.taawun.community) and automatic Let's Encrypt SSL/TLS certificates.
CRDT COLLABORATION PROTOCOL. Extend Web P2P relay with Yjs/Automerge binary update format for zero-lock concurrent state sync.
